title: Add Genie AI to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:

Fixes #14035

gist.headline: Genie joins the garden
gist.blurb: Genie AI has landed in the pollinations app garden. One more multimodal companion can now chat, search, summarize, and generally keep several tabs open at once.
gist.summary: Added Genie AI Companion to the app directory, highlighting its multimodal chat, live web-answer, document-analysis, and summarization capabilities.
gist.impact: People browsing pollinations-powered apps can now discover Genie AI as a single place for chat, internet answers, and document help.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming a friendly genie-themed app companion into a cozy garden hackerspace: a small glowing lamp releases pastel speech bubbles, document pages, and tiny web-search stars toward a retro terminal. Include blooming code-plants to represent the newly listed community app and make Polli feel like a host, wearing a tiny curator scarf.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the pollinations bee mascot, with a tiny curator scarf, welcoming a friendly pastel genie lamp beside a retro terminal in a blooming code garden; soft speech bubbles, document pages, and little web-search stars float from the lamp while flowers and vines grow around the desk. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, emotionally warm and inviting.
